hypothesis: A release report of the tasks before T165 (T001-T164) can be generated entirely from machine-readable queue metadata and their retained reports.
input_data: Retained reports of T001-T164 in the same output directory
mathematical_model: Scope T001-T164: T165 reads only earlier reports, so T165-T168 are not in it; queue-state.json and the dashboard cover the whole run. Totals over states, labels and basis components; queue coverage per section; runtime inventory = revision- or tree-bearing entries anywhere in each provider/runtime identity, one row per runtime with each identity it recorded (a revision recorded without its tree is merged with the entry that records that revision's tree); release digest = sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes of ciw.core.identities.canonical_json (sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII escapes, NaN refused; the encoding of report identities) of the list [[task, state, headline label, [[claim, label], ...]], ...] in queue order.
numerical_result: Release report of T001-T164: 164 of 168 queue tasks reported; states {'blocked': 2, 'completed': 147, 'partial': 15}; labels {'analytic': 11, 'numerically_verified': 805, 'provider_backed': 6, 'independently_verified': 63, 'not_established': 187}; basis components {'derivation': 142, 'independent_check': 63, 'provider': 92, 'reference_checks': 843, 'synthetic_inputs': 350, 'none': 165}; 9 runtimes (csg, ftr, plsr, ppda, rust, scr, scr-exchange, set, sp1) with 11 identities.
observation_model: No physical observation; reads retained computational records only.
